title: 第1章 一枚玉佩第2章 意外认主
content_zh:
;;
夜色浓稠如墨，沉甸甸地压在青云宗杂役峰的窝棚上。
风从绝壁间穿过，发出呜咽般的呼啸，如孩童哭泣，刮得屋顶腐朽的茅草，簌簌作响。
仿佛下一刻，房顶就要被整个掀飞。
空气里，弥漫着一股难以驱散的潮湿霉味。
此种气味倒是不难闻……
混杂着汗臭，劣质油脂灯烟味，以及远处灵兽棚飘来的浓重臊气……
小吸一口，就会呕吐不止……
陈平早就已经习惯这种气味。
他蜷缩在窝棚角落，勉强能称为“床铺”的枯草，就是他睡觉的地方。
单薄破旧的麻布衣，根本挡不住石壁沁出的寒意。
门缝里钻进来的冷风，冻得他瑟瑟发抖……
瘦削的身体，之所以如此扛不住寒风……
不是因为冷，而是饿……
真的很饿！
自从三年前上山以来，他还没有吃过一顿饱饭。
胃里空得发疼……
阵阵痉挛抽搐着，扯得他眼前发黑。
肚子里最后一点东西，是昨天傍晚那一碗杂粮饭。
那是他作为青云宗，最低等杂役弟子一整日辛苦劳作的全部所得。

只是，这点东西，对于高强度的工作而言，显然是不够的……
外面传来几声压抑的咳嗽和痛苦的呻吟。
其他同样挣扎在生死线上的杂役，只能硬挺挺的撑着，祈祷着寒夜的过去。
陈平闭上眼，强迫自己不去听，不去想。
黑暗里，白日里那碗杂粮饭的景象却固执地浮现出来……
浑浊的杂粮，上面甚至还留着不少灰尘。
负责分发食物的高级杂役弟子，那张不耐烦的脸，还有他手腕上，不经意滑出袖口的一小截金子做成的手镯……
那金子的光泽，和他此刻腹中的空虚，简直就是阶级地位的真实写照！
他猛地睁开眼……
空洞的眼睛，望着窝棚顶上一个被老鼠啃出来的破洞。
几点惨淡的星光，漏了进来，散发他的脸上，提醒着他，他还活着。
活着啊……
仅仅是为了活着……
如蝼蚁一样，在仙门巨擘的庇护下，靠着那点施舍般的杂粮饭，苟延残喘。
手指无意识地，抠进身下粗糙扎人的草垫。
陈平咬着牙……
content_en:
;;
The night was as thick as ink, pressing heavily on the shack of the Qingyun Sect's miscellaneous peak.
The wind passed through the cliffs, whistling like a child crying, making the rotten thatch on the roof rustle.
It seemed that the next moment, the entire roof would be blown off.
The air was filled with a damp musty smell that was hard to get rid of.
The smell is not unpleasant...
Mixed with the stench of sweat, low-quality grease, lamp smoke, and the thick smell wafting from the distant spirit animal shed...
One small puff will make you vomit...
Chen Ping has long been accustomed to this smell.
He huddled in the corner of the shack, and the withered grass that could barely be called a "bed" was where he slept.
The thin and worn linen clothes could not block the chill from the stone wall.
The cold wind that came in through the crack in the door made him shiver...
The reason why my skinny body can’t withstand the cold wind...
Not because of cold, but because of hunger...
Really hungry!
He has not had a full meal since he went up the mountain three years ago.
My stomach feels so empty...
Spasms and convulsions made his eyes black.
The last thing in my stomach was the bowl of multigrain rice from yesterday evening.
That was all he earned from a whole day's hard work as the lowest servant disciple of the Qingyun Sect.
However, this little thing is obviously not enough for high-intensity work...
There were several muffled coughs and painful moans coming from outside.
Other handymen who were also struggling on the line of life and death could only hold on and pray for the passing of the cold night.
Chen Ping closed his eyes and forced himself not to listen or think.
In the darkness, the scene of the bowl of multigrain rice during the day persisted...
The turbid grains even had a lot of dust on them.
The senior handyman disciple responsible for distributing food, the impatient face, and the small piece of gold bracelet on his wrist that accidentally slipped out of the cuff...
The luster of the gold and the emptiness in his belly at this moment were simply a true reflection of class status!
He opened his eyes suddenly...
His empty eyes stared at a hole gnawed by mice on the roof of the shack.
A few bleak starlight leaked in and spread on his face, reminding him that he was still alive.
Alive...
Just to live...
Like an ant, under the protection of the giants of the immortal sect, relying on the little grains of rice that are like charity, they are struggling to survive.
His fingers unconsciously dug into the rough and prickly straw mat beneath him.
Chen Ping gritted his teeth...
